name: Frothing Mug Tavern
desc1: This birghtly-lit tavern is filled with many drinking, talking
desc2: dwarves. Ale seems to be the drink of choice here, and most of them
desc3: have huge pitchers all to themselves. A bar against the southern wall
desc4: holds all the drinks, as well as the grill and firepit where the food
desc5: is cooked. To the east, a tall archway leads into the gambling hall.
